## Requirements: End-to-end byte boundedness at the ControlModeSession output handoff

### Background and ownership

Post-merge terminal review of [#2380](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/2380), [#2307](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/2307) and [#1645](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/1645), pinned to `main@8990fc28ffc6099656e5fbd0e4b25ad20e9c3e14`, found an independent boundedness gap **after** the typed `TmuxClient` ingress.

The current pipeline is:

```text
tmux -C/-CC stdout
  -> TmuxClient::EventSink (256 events, 32 MiB aggregate byte budget)
  -> EventStream::recv() [releases Client budget immediately on receive]
  -> ControlModeSession::forward_events
  -> mpsc::channel::<Vec<u8>>(OUTPUT_CHANNEL_CAPACITY=256) [count-only]
  -> Agent session stream / replay / peer fanout
```

Sources:
- [ControlModeSession::attach and OUTPUT_CHANNEL_CAPACITY](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/8990fc28ffc6099656e5fbd0e4b25ad20e9c3e14/crates/nession-agent/src/tmux/control.rs#L54-L67)
- [ControlModeSession::forward_events](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/8990fc28ffc6099656e5fbd0e4b25ad20e9c3e14/crates/nession-agent/src/tmux/control.rs#L503-L523)
- [EventStream::recv releases credit on take](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/8990fc28ffc6099656e5fbd0e4b25ad20e9c3e14/crates/nession-agent/src/tmux/client/mod.rs#L261-L271)
- [Agent consumes output_rx](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/8990fc28ffc6099656e5fbd0e4b25ad20e9c3e14/crates/nession-agent/src/server/websocket.rs#L2424-L2441)

**Verified source fact:** The adapter's downstream 256-slot output channel has no aggregate byte reservation, and Client ingress credit is released before Agent accepts the output. Hence the Client's 32 MiB budget cannot be taken as a whole-pipeline queued-memory bound. **Unverified**: no measured OOM or production memory incident is claimed; worst-case payload multiplication is a capacity illustration only.

This Requirement owns **the ControlModeSession handoff**. The typed Client's own admission timeout remains #2380, and Agent replay/subscriber/browser credit remain #1645/#1925. Do not add a competing EventStream, replay store, or stream epoch/seq owner.

### Desired outcome

- Define and enforce an aggregate byte budget at the output handoff, with exact charge/release timing and explicit event-count/oversize bounds; or transfer shared byte-credit ownership across the Client→adapter→Agent handoff without an uncharged queue.
- Ensure a stalled Agent output consumer produces a bounded, truthful failure/recovery outcome, without silently discarding stream bytes, blocking source-loss forever or fabricating synchronized checkpoint fidelity.
- Preserve single producer order and the existing `CaptureStarted` / capture/live cut, authoritative resize, Agent stream epoch/seq and input/ControlLease semantics; explain where credit transfers without a double-charge or an uncharged gap.
- Do not interpret a bounded `mpsc` item count as a useful upper bound on total payload bytes.

### Prototype

- Decision: Not needed
- Reason: internal resource accounting/stream delivery; no new interaction or UI shape.
- Status: Not needed

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 A source-aligned deterministic trace shows an explicit, measured aggregate byte bound across Client ingress and ControlModeSession output handoff (including pending-send and event-in-flight state), rather than only a 256-event count; budget is released exactly once by the correct owner.
- [ ] SC-02 With the Agent consumer deliberately stalled under large tmux output, a bounded-time overload/recovery outcome occurs within configured resource limits, without silent byte loss, false healthy stream state or misreported capture cut.
- [ ] SC-03 Existing capture/live ordering, resize/output order, Client source-loss cleanup and Agent epoch/seq/ControlLease contracts remain intact with no duplicate credit authority.
- [ ] SC-04 Real isolated tmux burst and a healthy peer vs stalled output-consumer integration Case establish the actual memory/queue budget and bounded recovery on an exact authenticated staging revision.

**Integration-runner prerequisite:** SC-02/04 require a trusted, least-privilege, authenticated staging Case lane with source SHA/Run/Attempt receipts; if this is not available, leave Pending. Do not replace with an unexecuted Agent opinion or move them to main solely for runner convenience.

## Product alignment

- [x] Supports VISION.md continuous terminal across devices.
- [x] Obeys PRINCIPLE.md; internal reliability, no new persistent UI.
- [x] Reviewed `crates/nession-agent/AGENTS.md`, `docs/design/terminal/ahp-inspired-terminal-consistency.md` and Control Mode transport architecture.
- [x] No deviation from single-source terminal stream authority.

**Deduplication:** #2380's accepted SC-01 covers the **Client** ingress budget, not the later `output_rx` buffer. #1645/#1925 own **Agent stream/replay/subscriber** credit, not the adapter-to-Agent queue. This is a new independent boundary, not a reopening of those unrelated accepted criteria.
